text:
sam: Heads-up — after the sample-set rebase this morning the diff inspector in console shows an empty list for a subset of scorecards. Happens when sample_count changes but the baseline_id is still the old one. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal/shot/abc123 :eyes:

maya: repro steps? I couldn't hit it locally.

sam: Steps i did quickly:
1) open scorecard -> diff -> select cohort A vs baseline
2) click 'rebase samples' (uses new_sampleset_id)
3) click 'inspect samples' -> empty list, but backend returns rows

curl that I used:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://console/api/scorecards/42/diff?cohort=A&baseline=baseline_v3"
```

devon: when i repro'd i saw 204 from /diff/inspect even though /diff returned 200 with payload. suspect frontend is reading the X-Result-Count header and treating 0 as empty (header missing after rebase).

cheng: looking at logs — after rebase we stream a compacted payload and set header `X-Result-Count` only on non-stream responses. stack snippet:
```
2024-05-21T09:12:10Z INFO diff_handler: baseline=baseline_v3 new=sampleset_20240521
2024-05-21T09:12:10Z DEBUG streamer: using chunked response, count_header=false
2024-05-21T09:12:10Z WARN api: sending 204 because client expected content-length
```

devon: that matches. frontend code expects header and fallback to [] if missing. quick fix: treat chunked but with content as truthy. i'll open a tiny patch to the diff-inspector widget to accept streamed responses.

eval-bot: CI run #5427 failed on e2e:diff-inspector — flake in test that mocks X-Result-Count. (link: https://ci.redwood/5427)

maya: we should fix backend too — client shouldn't have to special-case stream vs non-stream. cheng, can backend include `X-Result-Count` for streamed responses?

cheng: yeah I'll add the count header from the stream metadata. two changes: backend to always emit header when count known; frontend fallback to parse first chunk if header missing.

devon: PRs: frontend -> https://gh/redwood/frontend/pull/1892 (hotfix), backend -> https://gh/redwood/infra/pull/1427 (include header). i'll run canary on staging after merge.

sam: awesome. maya can you add a regression unit test patch that simulates rebase and chunked stream? also add an e2e that runs against staging diff inspector.

maya: on it, will add a mocked stream test and a small e2e.

cheng: pushed backend patch and added log to verify header present. will attach deploy window in the PR for a small canary.

devon: once merged i'll cut a staging deploy and smoke test with original repro steps. tagging @oncall for potential rollback.

sam: thanks all. I'll validate UX in staging once devon confirms smoke. leaving notes in the scorecard ticket 3917. :thumbsup:

cheng: post-deploy log snippet (staging):
```
2024-05-21T10:05:02Z INFO diff_handler: injected header X-Result-Count=124 for sampleset_20240521
```

sam: confirmed in staging — inspect shows samples again. closing thread after CI green.
